cases.summary: Infinite recursion in `maven_artifact` if `dest` is one-segment non-existent path
cases.description:
##### SUMMARY
`maven_artifact` has infinite recursion in `split_pre_existing_dir` if only one segment simple one-segment relative path passed to is doesn't exists yet.

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME
maven_artifact

##### ANSIBLE VERSION
```

  executable location = /usr/bin/ansible
  python version = 3.7.2 (default, Jan 10 2019, 23:51:51) [GCC 8.2.1 20181127]
```

##### CONFIGURATION
```

DEFAULT_HOST_LIST(/home/gross/.ansible.cfg) = ['/home/gross/repo/ansible-roles/servers-dev']
DEFAULT_KEEP_REMOTE_FILES(env: ANSIBLE_KEEP_REMOTE_FILES) = True

RETRY_FILES_ENABLED(/home/gross/.ansible.cfg) = False
```

##### OS / ENVIRONMENT

##### STEPS TO REPRODUCE

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
maven_artifact: fix #53713 - infinite recursion

##### SUMMARY
<!--- Describe the change below, including rationale and design decisions -->
Fixes #53713 - infinite recursion in `maven_artifact` when the destination path is a single relative directory.

##### ISSUE TYPE
<!--- Pick one below and delete the rest -->
- Bugfix Pull Request

##### COMPONENT NAME
<!--- Write the short name of the module, plugin, task or feature below -->
- maven_artifact

##### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This fixes the issue, however we have to consider if `maven_artifact` is supposed to crawl and create directories by itself.
evidence.eventual_fix_diff:
commit e2164c53789da32a45349833b705d9eb3669dd1b
Author: S. Veyrié <sylvain.veyrie@gmail.com>
Date:   Thu Mar 14 13:59:17 2019 +0100

    maven_artifact: Fix infinite recursion (#53734)
    
    Fixes: #53713

diff --git a/lib/ansible/modules/packaging/language/maven_artifact.py b/lib/ansible/modules/packaging/language/maven_artifact.py
index 4c4ee156c9..aa576f1b70 100644
--- a/lib/ansible/modules/packaging/language/maven_artifact.py
+++ b/lib/ansible/modules/packaging/language/maven_artifact.py
@@ -197,7 +197,10 @@ def split_pre_existing_dir(dirname):
     head, tail = os.path.split(dirname)
     b_head = to_bytes(head, errors='surrogate_or_strict')
     if not os.path.exists(b_head):
-        (pre_existing_dir, new_directory_list) = split_pre_existing_dir(head)
+        if head == dirname:
+            return None, [head]
+        else:
+            (pre_existing_dir, new_directory_list) = split_pre_existing_dir(head)
     else:
         return head, [tail]
     new_directory_list.append(tail)
@@ -209,7 +212,11 @@ def adjust_recursive_directory_permissions(pre_existing_dir, new_directory_list,
     Walk the new directories list and make sure that permissions are as we would expect
     '''
     if new_directory_list:
-        working_dir = os.path.join(pre_existing_dir, new_directory_list.pop(0))
+        first_sub_dir = new_directory_list.pop(0)
+        if not pre_existing_dir:
+            working_dir = first_sub_dir
+        else:
+            working_dir = os.path.join(pre_existing_dir, first_sub_dir)
         directory_args['path'] = working_dir
         changed = module.set_fs_attributes_if_different(directory_args, changed)
         changed = adjust_recursive_directory_permissions(working_dir, new_directory_list, module, directory_args, changed)
